title: Certificate split encoding
statement: Let $C,c$ be nonnegative integers and let $w$ be a bit string. If the split-selection procedure returns an index $i$ for the length of $w$, encode the prefix of $w$ of length $i$ together with the remaining suffix using the self-delimiting pairing; if it returns no index, output the empty bit string.
caveat: The formal statement uses `solveSplit`, whose definition is not included, so the precise criterion for selecting a split index cannot be stated.
